title: Taskbar
description: The taskbar module displays the currently open applications. This module requires a compositor that implements the foreign-toplevel-manager interface.

placeholders.description: The application name as in desktop file if appropriate desktop files are found, otherwise same as {app_id}
The app_id (== application name) of the application.
The state (minimized, maximized, active, fullscreen) of the application.
The state (minimize == m, maximized == M, active == A, fullscreen == F) represented as one character of the application.

all-outputs.label: All outputs
all-outputs.doc: If set to false applications on the waybar's current output will be shown. Otherwise, all applications are shown.
all-outputs.description: If set to false applications on the waybar's current output will be shown. Otherwise, all applications are shown.

bar-css-states.label: Bar CSS states
bar-css-states.doc: If set to true, application state is exposed as CSS classes on the Waybar window. Maximized and fullscreen state is aggregated across applications known to belong to the active workspace. See Bar state style below.
bar-css-states.description: If set to true, application state is exposed as CSS classes on the Waybar window. Maximized and fullscreen state is aggregated across applications known to belong to the active workspace. See Bar state style below.

format.label: What to show
format.doc: The format, how information should be displayed.
format.description: The text shown in the bar. Words in curly braces, like {icon}, are replaced with live values: see the list of placeholders.

icon-theme.label: Icon theme
icon-theme.doc: The names of the icon-themes that should be used to find an icon. The list will be traversed from left to right. If omitted, the system default will be used.
icon-theme.description: The names of the icon-themes that should be used to find an icon. The list will be traversed from left to right. If omitted, the system default will be used.

markup.label: Markup
markup.doc: If set to true, pango markup will be accepted in format and tooltip-format.
markup.description: If set to true, pango markup will be accepted in format and tooltip-format.

tooltip.label: Show tooltip
tooltip.doc: If set to false no tooltip will be shown.
tooltip.description: Show a small popup with more details when the mouse is over the module.

tooltip-format.label: Tooltip text
tooltip-format.doc: The format, how information in the tooltip should be displayed.
tooltip-format.description: What the popup shows. It uses the same placeholders as the bar text.

active-first.label: Active first
active-first.doc: If set to true, always reorder the tasks in the taskbar so that the currently active one is first. Otherwise don't reorder.
active-first.description: If set to true, always reorder the tasks in the taskbar so that the currently active one is first. Otherwise don't reorder.

active-only.label: Active only
active-only.doc: If set to true, only the currently active application button is shown. Other applications remain tracked and reappear when activated.
active-only.description: If set to true, only the currently active application button is shown. Other applications remain tracked and reappear when activated.

sort-by-app-id.label: Sort by app ID
sort-by-app-id.doc: If set to true, group tasks by their app_id. Cannot be used with 'active-first'.
sort-by-app-id.description: If set to true, group tasks by their app_id. Cannot be used with 'active-first'.

homogeneous.label: Homogeneous
homogeneous.doc: If set to true, distribute every task button evenly across the taskbar's allocated width. Buttons will automatically resize so that 'N' visible tasks each take '1/N' of the width.
homogeneous.description: If set to true, distribute every task button evenly across the taskbar's allocated width. Buttons will automatically resize so that 'N' visible tasks each take '1/N' of the width.

justify.label: Line alignment
justify.doc: The alignment of the text within the module's box, allowing options 'left', 'right', or 'center' to define the positioning.
justify.description: How lines are aligned when the text has more than one line.

expand.label: Fill empty space
expand.doc: If set to true, task buttons stretch to fill the available space in the taskbar and long titles are ellipsized to fit. Only takes effect on a horizontal bar; on a vertical bar the buttons keep their content-based size. If set to false, buttons are sized to their content.
expand.description: Stretch the module to use all the free space left in its section.

truncate.label: Truncate
truncate.doc: If set to true, the task button text will be ellipsized (truncated with …) when the available button width is smaller than the label text.
truncate.description: If set to true, the task button text will be ellipsized (truncated with …) when the available button width is smaller than the label text.

on-click.label: Left click runs
on-click.doc: The action which should be triggered when clicking on the application button with the left mouse button.
on-click.description: A command to run when you click the module. Empty keeps the normal behavior.

on-click-middle.label: Middle click runs
on-click-middle.doc: The action which should be triggered when clicking on the application button with the middle mouse button.
on-click-middle.description: A command to run when you click the module with the mouse wheel.

on-click-right.label: Right click runs
on-click-right.doc: The action which should be triggered when clicking on the application button with the right mouse button.
on-click-right.description: A command to run when you right-click the module.

on-update.label: On every refresh run
on-update.doc: Command to execute when the module is updated.
on-update.description: A command to run each time the module updates.

ignore-list.label: Ignore list
ignore-list.doc: List of app_id/titles to be invisible.
ignore-list.description: List of app_id/titles to be invisible.

squash-list.label: Squash list
squash-list.doc: List of app_id/titles whose multiple instances are collapsed into a single button. When more than one instance of a listed app is open, only one button is shown; when one instance closes, the next hidden instance reappears. The special value '*' matches all applications.
squash-list.description: List of app_id/titles whose multiple instances are collapsed into a single button. When more than one instance of a listed app is open, only one button is shown; when one instance closes, the next hidden instance reappears. The special value '*' matches all applications.

app_ids-mapping.label: App ids mapping
app_ids-mapping.doc: Dictionary of app_id to be replaced with
app_ids-mapping.description: Dictionary of app_id to be replaced with

rewrite.label: Rewrite
rewrite.doc: Rules to rewrite the module format output. See rewrite rules.
rewrite.description: Rules to rewrite the module format output. See rewrite rules.
